title: put on weight — Samuel Langhorne Clemens

sentences.sentence: I had put on weight after having our daughter, so felt incredibly worthless.
sentences.translation: 生完女儿后我的体重增加，产生了难以置信的自卑感。

sentences.sentence: Many over-40s begin to eat too much, put on weight and cut down on the amount of daily exercise they take, according to a new study.
sentences.translation: 根据一项新研究，许多人一过40岁就开始过度饮食，体重增加，减少每日的运动量。

sentences.sentence: In any case, people should not put on weight in hopes of preventing glaucoma, Kishor said. “Don’t gain weight thinking that it might somehow protect you, ” he said.
sentences.translation: 不论如何，人们都不应该抱着一种预防青光眼的希望来增肥，基肖尔说，“千万不要在体重增加的同时心想这么做可能会保护你自己”。

sentences.sentence: the need to strengthen international co-operation
sentences.translation: 加强国际合作的需要

sentences.translation: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

sentences.translation: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

sentences.translation: 醋酸是醋的主要有效成分。

sentences.translation: 你要哪种味道的，巧克力还是香草？

sentences.sentence: The stories have a strong regional flavour.
sentences.translation: 这些故事有很强的地方色彩。

sentences.sentence: Mark Twain travel anywhere in all his life , his adventure aboard is the material of his works.
sentences.translation: 马克·吐温一生中到处旅游，他在国外的历险经历是他一些作品的素材。

sentences.sentence: Ron Powers is the author of Mark Twain: A Life, and Sam and Laura, a play about Twain and his lost love.
sentences.translation: 罗恩·鲍沃斯，《山姆和劳拉：马克·吐温的爱情人生》的作者，一部关于马克·吐温失去的爱情的戏剧。

sentences.sentence: “On one of my visits we happened to be talking about Mark Twain, ” Byrd wrote to Gold.
sentences.translation: “一次拜访中，我们碰巧谈到了马克·吐温，”伯德在给古尔特的信中写道。

sentences.sentence: And in fact it is just shown in percentages, less than a quarter of the painting itself deals with Hannibal and his army, and the rest is this swollen angry sky with the sun just flickering through.

sentences.translation: 为了这个职位，他从俄亥俄州举家搬迁到密苏里州，并且买了一幢房子。

sentences.sentence: There are now no more straight boring roads, and the deadly humidity of Missouri and others states are behind me.
sentences.translation: 现在不再有那些笔直单调的长路了，密苏里和其它几个州的湿热也留在了我身后。

sentences.sentence: In Missouri, the same factors cut my victory margin almost in half, from 10 to 6 percent.

put on weight
增加体重
例句：I had put on weight after having our daughter, so felt incredibly worthless.
生完女儿后我的体重增加，产生了难以置信的自卑感。
例句：Many over-40s begin to eat too much, put on weight and cut down on the amount of daily exercise they take, according to a new study.
根据一项新研究，许多人一过40岁就开始过度饮食，体重增加，减少每日的运动量。
例句：In any case, people should not put on weight in hopes of preventing glaucoma, Kishor said. “Don’t gain weight thinking that it might somehow protect you, ” he said.
不论如何，人们都不应该抱着一种预防青光眼的希望来增肥，基肖尔说，“千万不要在体重增加的同时心想这么做可能会保护你自己”。

例句：Ron Powers is the author of Mark Twain: A Life, and Sam and Laura, a play about Twain and his lost love.

Missouri
音标：英 /mi'zuəri/  美 /mɪ'zʊri/
n. 密苏里州（美国州名）
短语：missouri river — n. 密苏里河

为了这个职位，他从俄亥俄州举家搬迁到密苏里州，并且买了一幢房子。
例句：There are now no more straight boring roads, and the deadly humidity of Missouri and others states are behind me.
现在不再有那些笔直单调的长路了，密苏里和其它几个州的湿热也留在了我身后。
例句：In Missouri, the same factors cut my victory margin almost in half, from 10 to 6 percent.
在密苏里州，同样的因素让我的获胜优势几乎减少了一半，从10%降到6%。

Mississippi
n. 密西西比河；密西西比州（美国州名）
例句：This land drains into the Mississippi.
该地区向密西西比河排水。
例句：To be sure the President has encouraged this trend -- but in Mississippi I didn\'t get the impression that they needed much encouragement from far off Washington.
总统确实鼓励这种趋势。 但是在密西西比州，我并没有获得这样的印象，他们需要从遥远之地的华盛顿获得大量的鼓励。
例句：It is a little river compared to the Amazon or the Missouri and Mississippi.
与亚马逊河或密苏里河和密西西比河相比，它是条小河。
